name: DataAgent
author: Artistudio

sections.description:
🧠 Meet DataAgent – the powerful AI-driven solution that transforms your raw data into actionable business insights!

DataAgent analyzes your WooCommerce data to uncover patterns, trends, and opportunities that would otherwise remain hidden.

Make smarter, data-driven decisions without needing to be a data scientist or analytics expert.

Whether you’re tracking sales performance or product performance, DataAgent makes complex data simple to understand and act upon.

External services

DataAgent is a plugin that helps you to connect your websites to AI services like OpenAI. You need your own API keys and must follow the rules set by the AI service. For OpenAI, check their Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. It is also important to check your usage on the OpenAI website for accurate information. Please do so with other services as well.

We leverage OpenAI as our chosen AI service provider to transform your raw data into actionable insights. To facilitate this, we transmit a defined set of your WooCommerce product data, including: (Product Name, Product Description, Product Price, Product Regular Price, Product Sale Price, Total Sold, Total Revenue, Units Sold This Month, Stock Quantity, Categories, Tags)

It is important to note that this data transmission is strictly limited. It occurs exclusively during your direct, user-initiated chat interactions on a WooCommerce product page. This ensures that your data is only processed when you actively engage with the service.

Disclaimer

The developer of DataAgent and related parties are not responsible for any issues or losses caused by using the plugin or AI-generated content. You should talk to a legal expert and follow the laws and regulations of your country. DataAgent does only store data on your own server, and it is your responsibility to keep it safe.
sections.installation:
Instruction :

  • You can install the plugin from the WordPress Plugin Repositories or
  • Download the plugin and extract the zip file and just drop the contents in the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation
  • Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  • Go to the WooCommerce product page and check the DataAgent insights
